ddl.value:
("actor_kind" = 'user' and "actor_user_id" is not null)
        or ("actor_kind" = 'system' and "actor_user_id" is null)
ddl.name: event_actor_attribution_check

ddl.value:
("status" = 'processing' and "lease_token" is not null and "lease_expires_at" is not null)
    or ("status" <> 'processing' and "lease_token" is null and "lease_expires_at" is null)
ddl.name: email_lease_check

ddl.value:
("status" in ('pending', 'processing') and "encrypted_payload" is not null)
    or ("status" in ('sent', 'failed', 'expired', 'cancelled') and "encrypted_payload" is null)
ddl.name: email_payload_check

ddl.value:
("bootstrap_token_hash" is null and "bootstrap_token_issued_at" is null and "bootstrap_token_expires_at" is null)
    or ("bootstrap_token_hash" is not null and "bootstrap_token_hash" <> ''
      and "bootstrap_token_issued_at" is not null and "bootstrap_token_expires_at" is not null)
ddl.name: installation_token_fields_check

ddl.value:
("grant_source" = 'owner' and "granted_by_user_id" is not null)
    or ("grant_source" in ('bootstrap', 'operator_recovery') and "granted_by_user_id" is null)
ddl.name: owner_grant_actor_check

ddl.value:
"revoked_at" is not null
    or ("revoked_by_user_id" is null and "revocation_reason" is null)
ddl.name: owner_revocation_metadata_check

ddl.value: not ("consumed_at" is not null and "revoked_at" is not null)
ddl.name: verification_terminal_check

ddl.value: ("consumed_at" is null or "consumed_at" >= "created_at") and ("revoked_at" is null or "revoked_at" >= "created_at")
ddl.name: verification_terminal_time_check

ddl.value: ("user_id" is null and "user_email_id" is null and "email_job_id" is null) or ("user_id" is not null and "user_email_id" is not null and "email_job_id" is not null)
ddl.name: verification_source_check
